blocks.text: IonButton is a button component with Ionic styles. Its click handler can update local React state.
Use an Ionic React starter with its setupIonicReact call and standard Ionic CSS imports. Put these components in App.tsx or App.jsx. The plain playground does not load Ionic styles or components.
